title: Speaking Part 2 — one minute, three jobs
note:
Derived from pictures-data.json, which every page in this folder already reads. Nothing is invented: each model turn is split at sentence boundaries and each sentence priced at 2.5 words a second.

The point of the split is the arithmetic. Every one of the eight model turns runs 67 to 80 seconds against a 60-second limit, so a student cannot say all of it — which is the real task. Part 2 is not an extension exercise like Part 1; it is a budgeting one, and the failure it punishes is spending fifty seconds describing and ten on the question.

So the phases are ordered and the clock is hard. Linger and you are cut off before the question, exactly as the interlocutor cuts you off.

advice: roughly half the minute on the photos and half on the question. The source data already agrees — answer_question is the longest step in all eight topics.
